sanskrit_verse:
शूलैर् भेत्स्यन्ति चाक्रुद्धाः क्रोशन्तम् अपरायणम् ।
अवाक्शीरसम् उत्क्षिप्य क्षेप्स्यन्ति अग्निह्रदेषु च ॥
transliteration: śūlair bhetsyanti cākruddhāḥ krośantam aparāyaṇam | avākśirasam utkṣipya kṣepsyanti agnihradeṣu ca ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who act without anger shall pierce with tridents one who cries out in desperation and then cast him upside-down into fire-pits.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in conscious detachment from emotional disturbance during execution of justice.
Causation arises from the inversion of dignity as a proportional response to unregulated expression of helplessness.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by one's ability to maintain alignment while executing corrective action.
Restoration logic operates through symbolic reversal of the disruption caused by unchecked lamentation.
Consciousness alignment requires the neutralization of reactive impulses in favor of precise, restorative conduct.
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor exhibits no sign of emotive disturbance AND target displays unregulated outcry THEN authorize piercing with ceremonial instrument.
IF subject is rendered supine through prior act THEN mandate positional inversion before environmental immersion.
IF environment supports purification by heat THEN execute placement within designated thermal zone.
IF capacity for alignment remains intact in executor THEN permit continuation of protocol sequence.
IF completion state is reached THEN terminate operational cycle with declaration of causal balance.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, this verse establishes that only those whose consciousness remains undisturbed may execute correctional measures. Emotional neutrality becomes the threshold for lawful intervention. The Court must assess_executor_stability before validating procedural adherence.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa confirms that uncontrolled vocalization disrupts social equilibrium; hence, corrective action follows anupūrvaśaḥ—first containment (piercing), then inversion (loss of orientation), culminating in elemental exposure (fire). This sequence aligns consequence with causality without punitive intent. Responsibility is measured by inner stillness, not external harm.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate ceremonial piercing under supervision to ensure neutrality of intent.
Perform positional inversion to recalibrate sensory perception and halt chaotic emission.
Immerse temporarily in purifying fire-pit to burn residual dissonance and restore clarity.
Verify cessation of disruptive outcry as signal of process completion.
Reintegrate individual post-resolution through guided consciousness realignment session.
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this enactment restores cosmic order through precise alignment of cause and consequence. Justice flows from consciousness unmoved by reaction. Reality abides in non-punitive precision. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
